modelo_ou_modo: Imagem, Qualidade 2.0, x4, 4:3; edicoes pela caixa 'Descreva sua edicao'
prompt: a beach volleyball match on the sand in the golden afternoon with 5 characters: Blueberrini Octopusini (cute round purple blueberry octopus with big eyes) jumping to hit the volleyball; Bombardiro Crocodilo (crocodile head on a propeller airplane body, dropping confetti) cheering with pom-poms; La Vaca Saturno Saturnita (planet Saturn with a cow face and two big human feet) laughing; Ballerina Cappuccina (ballerina in a pink tutu with a cappuccino cup head) carrying a basket; Brr Brr Patapim (tree trunk with a mossy head, a long nose and huge bare feet) playing a guitar. Around them: a volleyball net, a striped volleyball, a referee chair, beach towels, sunglasses, coolers, a smoothie stand, palm trees, kites in the sky and beach umbrellas. wide shot, busy scene packed with small distinct objects over the whole picture, no empty areas, everything in sharp focus, all characters medium size and fully visible, cute, no weapons, no text, no logo, no watermark, 4:3, flat 2D cartoon illustration, thick clean black outlines, flat bright colors with simple cel shading, children's comic book style, crisp clear shapes

edicoes.prompt: Edit this image. Make exactly these changes and nothing else: 1) Put round black sunglasses on the eyes of the purple octopus. 2) Make the two pink pom-poms held by the crocodile in the airplane yellow. 3) Make the pink kite at the top left green. 4) Make the purple cooler on the sand at the bottom left red. 5) Make the green cooler box on the sand at the bottom center orange. 6) Make the brown ukulele played by the tree trunk character on the right bright red. Keep the composition, camera, style, colors, lighting and every other detail exactly the same.
mudancas: oculos escuros redondos pretos no Blueberrini Octopusini
os dois pompons do Bombardiro Crocodilo rosa -> amarelos
pipa rosa do alto a esquerda -> verde (rabo de fitas tambem verde)
caixa termica roxa no canto inferior esquerdo -> vermelha
caixa termica verde pequena no centro-baixo -> laranja
ukulele marrom do Brr Brr Patapim -> vermelho

notas: Rodada 1: candidata 1 tinha um polvo extra no ceu; a 2 tinha um personagem-xicara extra; a 3 tinha dois bebes-xicara extras. Escolhida a 4: os 5 personagens fieis (Blueberrini com coroa de mirtilo, Bombardiro no aviao com pompons, Saturnita com pes humanos, Ballerina com cesta, Patapim com nariz comprido, musgo, pes descalcos e ukulele), sem tubarao, sem cena submarina. Ha figurantes humanos de desenho: o juiz na cadeira (alto a esquerda) e uma plateia pequena ao fundo a direita. O centro da areia tem so confete. As duas edicoes fizeram as 6 mudancas, sem deslocar o enquadramento.
